allow_instructions: Allow repository reads, ordinary source and documentation edits, local tests, linting, type checks, builds, read-only Git inspection, feature-branch staging, preview deployments, and creation of local migration files when they stay within the approved task scope.
block_instructions: Require review or block access to secret-bearing files, destructive Git/history operations, force pushes, production deployments, remote database or infrastructure mutations, state-changing MCP tools, delegated production actions, and any modification or deletion of protected agent-governance and enforcement files.
